from_mixlab: Every hybrid file links its parents and subjects to JAH Wiki via https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/jah-wiki/?page=<subject> and to the IWB Dictionary via https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/jah-dictionary/?w=<word> for word-born parents.
from_wiki: Wiki MIX: pages link back to the canonical hybrid file at https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-ai-mixlab/?mix=JAH-MIX-######.
note: How Mix Lab hybrids resolve as JAH Wiki articles. Lightweight cross-link spec — no edits to the wiki repo's data.
resolution: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/jah-wiki/?page=MIX:JAH-MIX-###### resolves a hybrid article: the wiki reads the hybrid's file live from the Mix Lab (mentality, abilities, lineage, parent links) and renders it as a standard JAH Wiki article.
